mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.title, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM conversation_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id) AS message_count FROM conversations c WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND (#{q}::text IS NULL OR c.title ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.content ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')) ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND user_id = #{userId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversations (id, kb_id, user_id, title) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{userId}, #{title})
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, steps, sources, resolved, tool_exchange, stopped) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{steps}, #{sources}, #{resolved}, #{toolExchange}, #{stopped})
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.role, m.content, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages later WHERE later.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND (later.created_at, later.id) > (m.created_at, m.id)) AS last FROM conversation_messages m WHERE m.id = #{messageId} AND m.conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT id, role, content, resolved, tool_exchange, sources, stopped FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
